patches.notes: User reviewed video/audio and explicitly requested promotion on2026-10-28. Exact tested48-byte terrain visibility patch; no new scratch. Known framebuffer/audio/RAM differences remain documented; bounded native gain and save/reset/reload/rollback checks passed. Full-game and complete RAM-liveness qualification are not claimed.

validated.fb: 15,600 frames: six top-screen differences at 14357,14359,14479,14481,14483,14485; all bottom screens exact. All 600 target-window screen pairs exact.
validated.ram: Strict failure retained. Main-RAM writers classify projection/model/graphics-transfer state; full replay transfer bookkeeping is consistent. DTCM liveness and complete reader equivalence remain unqualified. Only exact48-byte code normalized.
validated.audio: 239,992 of 12,516,274 stereo samples differ; maximum channel delta 1,215 and RMS 9.153. Audibility unjudged. User approved the presented control/candidate review on2026-10-28.
validated.save: Original reference save exact. Native candidate ordinary Save, soft-reset Continue, patched cold session reload and unpatched control reload passed; all loaded scene PNGs identical and generated save unchanged across resets/reloads. Bounded Twinleaf Town coverage.
validated.native: Two alternating control/candidate outdoor trials, same boundary route, stock1GHz, rc12 FPGA and accepted Beta2 renderer. Controls16.7726/17.2525; candidates19.1382/19.3653 complete screen-buffer publications/s. Saves preserved and OBS added no drops. Indoor idle59.7131 versus59.6371. Three further sessions passed native save/reset/cold-load and house entry/exit, including unpatched rollback save compatibility. No physical power-cycle or instruction-cache readback claim. Reference reset comparison completed; full RAM liveness and broader scene coverage remain unqualified.
validated.user_review: Everything looks good, followed by explicit just promote it,. works great. Accepted as a perceptual private beta.
validated.reset_reference: 12000 frames: both screens, final save and all7 full RAM checkpoints exact outside authenticated48 codebytes; transient state/audio differences retained. Audio184514/9627902 stereo samples differ, max4058,RMS40.630. This reset comparison was not in the previously reviewed video.
